All three searches were logged (log_001 through log_003); plan item pli_001 was updated to `in_progress`.

**Search Results Summary**

Searches were run in the Norwegian church marriage index (FamilySearch collection 1468080, covering 1660–1926) for the marriage of Unna Halsteinsdatter.

The search under her name exactly as written returned nothing, because the index transcribed her name differently — the bride appears in the record as **"Urna Halsteinsdr,"** a known quirk of how 18th-century Norwegian Gothic-script handwriting was read by transcribers. Once variant spellings were tried, a single matching record surfaced:

> **Marriage of Anders Monsen and Urna Halsteinsdr**
> Date: 25 June 1786
> Place: Hamre, Hordaland, Norway
> Collection: Norway, Marriages, 1660–1926 (FamilySearch collection 1468080)

The groom's name, place, and time period all fit what is known about the couple, and FamilySearch's systems have already linked this record to the family.

**Next step:** Shall I proceed with extracting the marriage record into the research project as a sourced assertion?
